docs.summary: How the scene view draws navmeshes. View state set by the editor, never saved with a scene.

Draw every surface's walkable overlay, not only the selected one's. The only way to watch obstacles carve while playing, since entering play mode clears the selection. Each overlay re-triangulates whenever its navmesh settles, so leave it off while profiling.
Add the height detail wireframe, the triangles Recast fits inside each polygon.
Add a marker per navmesh vertex, polygon corners picked out from detail vertices.
Stable debug color for an area index (Walkable is the familiar navmesh blue).
